name: luismc-artifacts
description: Project artifacts that show an owner what is live, running and waiting without reading code or chat. A feature artifact per feature (a standalone HTML file in the repository, never published) and one full-progress artifact per project (the only claude.ai artifact, published once per turn) are generated from a record in the repository (docs/artifacts/: manifest, task registry, content) to ARTIFACTSPEC 1.1.0. A feature artifact also records the owner's choices between options (decisions.json), each option shown with the chosen one marked. `feature-artifact-new` and `full-progress-artifact-new` create them in the project's own design, `task-add` and `task-status-update` change the registry through the script, and `project-artifact-check` audits a project's artifacts against the spec. Hooks queue status changes from pull-request, CI and deploy commands and block the end of a turn until Full Progress is published and background work has a Running task; the plugin delivers its rule (every activity is a task) at each session start; the record is the source, so a deleted artifact is recreated from it.
